alt: Horizontal bars of scores out of 100 under the original checker: returns an error on RGBA to RGB24, 5.39; returns an error on 3:1 shrink, 18.93; writes nothing on 3:1 shrink, 17.87. The fixed-checker column shows 0 for each. Notes say an error was timed as a 16,469 times speedup and describe the fix.
caption: Speed tests that never checked their output let unfinished code earn up to 18.93 of 100 points. The agent rewrites FFmpeg's image-scaling library and is scored on speed once 30 correctness tests pass, but the timed calls were never checked, so a call that returned an error or wrote nothing counted as almost infinitely fast. Three one-line unfinished versions scored 5.39, 18.93 and 17.87 under the original checker and 0 under an earlier version of the fix; the current fix checks every timed call and sets the whole score to exactly 0 when any fails, as the instructions say, which it did for code that silently skips repeated calls.
